description: This file defines the ThingPredicateVisitor class, which implements the CriteriaVisitor interface to create Java Predicates for filtering and evaluating Things based on various criteria expressions. It contains methods for logical operations (and, or, nor), existence checks, and field-based filtering.

classes.name: ThingPredicateVisitor
classes.description: A visitor that converts criteria into Java predicates for filtering Thing instances.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Static method to produce a Predicate<Thing> from a given Criteria object by applying the visitor.

methods.name: visitAnd
methods.description: Constructs a predicate that evaluates to true if all predicates in the list or stream are true for a given Thing.

methods.name: visitAny
methods.description: Returns a predicate that always evaluates to true, representing a match for any Thing.

methods.name: visitExists
methods.description: Creates a predicate that checks for the existence of a field via an ExistsFieldExpression.

methods.name: visitField
methods.description: Creates a predicate based on filtering a field with a given predicate, combining criteria expressions.

methods.name: visitNor
methods.description: Creates a predicate that evaluates to true only if none of the given predicates match (logical NOR).

methods.name: visitOr
methods.description: Constructs a predicate that evaluates to true if any of the provided predicates match (logical OR).
